overview: White answers the Latvian with 3.g4, attacking f5. The main idea is that after 3...fxg4 4.Nxe5 Qf6 White has a lead in development and threats. The position is unbalanced and dubious for the side that falls behind.

white_ideas.idea: Hit f5 with g4 and play Nxe5 in the follow-up
Use d4 and Bc4 against a loosened Black king

black_ideas.idea: Take on g4 and aim for ...Qf6 counter
Keep the extra pawn and rely on the exposed White king

typical_structures.structure: Open centre, loosened kingside on both sides

character.notes: Both kings are exposed and tactics decide.

gambit.notes: White's g-pawn is offered and Nxe5 follows.

soundness.notes: Weakens White's own king; most analysts prefer Black.

sublines_that_differ.name: Blackburne Shilling-style
sublines_that_differ.how: The main reply to the Latvian, not this variation.
